title: Vd veil aim line script
features:
Hello there here is the Violence district script made for the Veil killer, since many people have difficultly playing the Veil i have made a script that creates a line which shows you where you are aiming and where it will land

Like always this script is fully keyless so there are no hideen keysystems

Exploits to use(recomended):

Join violence district and execute infinite yeild, go to the bar and type esp(recomended) so you can see all survivor locations and snipe them easily with through the veil, and then you can add whatever you want

Features:

- aim line with arc

- in game tutorial(after loading screen)

- end point(shows you where the spear will land

How to use:

1. Join the game

2. Execute infinite yeild(recomended and optional)

3. Wait for you turn as killer and wait until you are fully loaded in(very important if you miss this step the line will sometimes bug out)

4. Have fun and destroy the lobby!

There is a full guide in the tutorial once you execute the script

This script is still brand new and will contain bugs, tell me if there are any bugs via the comments, there will be updates to this script soon

If you enjoyed my script please like it and make it blow up so it can reach as many people as possible!

If you see someone reuploading this script with a key system or for money you are getting scammed!, please report them, this is the original script, any other reuploads of this script(even with credits) will be considered stolen
